source.title: 小级别确认
text: 第一次跌到 1.618 之后，开始监控
监控失效原则:  有 3 条 15mink 创新低？
等 15min 级别站上 6 条均线，且后面 3 根 k 线都没有跌回来
等回踩 6 条线最高的那条线  如果当前点位回到了周区间内则失效
入场，止损放最低点那条线下面一点，目标周一高点 和另外一边的 1.618    空头反之
source.image_review: Both WIFUSDT 15-minute screenshots viewed on the original Notion page. The second risk box visually ends near the lower MA envelope, above the earlier price low. This is interpretive evidence, not a numeric stop-buffer definition.

Preserve gaps and per-symbol coverage; no downloads or source substitution. WIFUSDT September16 example is absent from the old229-symbol tail but present here.

first_touch: First observed post-Monday directional touch per NY week; crypto requires an uninterrupted weekly prefix

control_protocol: Three random alternative eligible15m submission closes per signal: same symbol, actual NY week, side, existing lagged14bar ATR/open volatility bucket; after first touch, before invalidation, complete/warmed, close beyond six MAs, valid resting geometry. Same contemporaneous MA repricing/0.5% stop/weekly target rules and costs, without requiring four consecutive reclaim closes. These are matched eligible-order-timing controls, not identical absolute risk-distance controls. Pair only when all three are filled, closed and in the same chronological segment; retain all missing/nonfills.

implementation_interpretations.new_extremes: First complete15m touch candle establishes running adverse extreme. Each later complete15m candle strictly refreshing it adds one; cumulative third invalidates only still-pending monitoring/orders at that close.
implementation_interpretations.ma_confirmation: First complete15m close strictly beyond all six MAs plus three subsequent consecutive closes still beyond; reset consecutive count on failure. Only first sequence per weekly directional monitor.
implementation_interpretations.entry_line: Long maximum, short minimum of completed15m six-MA envelope. Reprice only after a later complete15m close; marketable/invalid revised limits are cancelled, not retrospectively filled.
implementation_interpretations.stop_freeze: Long minMA*0.995, short maxMA*1.005 at latest unfilled amendment; freeze upon native fill. No breakeven, trail or post-fill new-extreme cancellation.
implementation_interpretations.range_invalidation: Before fill, first price touch back into near Monday boundary cancels. Native O-H-L-C execution segments arbitrate boundary versus limit ordering. Monitoring before submission uses the same stated path.
implementation_interpretations.monitor_expiry: Only current trigger NY week; unfilled orders expire at next NY Monday00:00 close. Positions keep original anchors and have no elapsed/weekly timeout.
implementation_interpretations.position_expiry: Source end or unexpected crypto gap/spot conflict boundary marks unresolved; boundary liquidation only for native accounting, excluded from closed trade win/return metrics.
implementation_interpretations.half_each: Equal original quantities at Monday opposite edge and opposite1618. Sum half of each native independent leg payoff and per-fill cost; no interaction/breakeven, therefore no duplicate replay is needed.

matching_volatility_feature: Existing log2 volatility bucket boundaries, but measured at the completed submission5m bar: previous14 completed5m true ranges divided by that same submission bar open. Never divide by the next bar open, which is not known at submission.
